text:
alex: Quick sync — customers are pushing back on v2 breaking changes; we need a pragmatic route-level contract + fallback plan.

maria: Can we list the top customer asks? I have notes: embeddings param rename, rerank signature change, function-calling payload shape.

jonathan: Runtime idea: support a `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` header that triggers a small mapping shim. Prefer header over route duplication.

sara: Shims are fine but add complexity. We should require SDKs to include the header by default during migration window.

prasad: Benchmarks: v2 perf +15% latency, token cost -8%. Biggest break: `response.choices[].text` -> `outputs.primary.text` for structured output.

alex: Proposed timeline:
- Phase 0: announce + doc + migration tool (this week)
- Phase 1: SDK + runtime shim (3 months)
- Phase 2: opt-in deprecation (next 3 months)
- Phase 3: removal for hosted default at 12 months
(enterprise contracts can opt for longer windows)

eva: Tool-calling: are we changing `arguments` -> `args`? Customers depend on exact keys for codegen.

jonathan: We'll freeze shape changes for tool-calling; mapping layer handles aliases. If aliasing has perf cost, we'll flag it.

maria: Launch criteria checklist:
- Py/JS SDKs ship with migration helpers
- Migration guide + examples + postman/curl snippets
- Auto-migration CLI that rewrites simple cases
- Monitoring dashboard + regression alerts
- Canary @1% + rollback playbook

prasad: Note: Dedicated/private customers often ask for non-breaking patches only. Add exemption path in contract templates.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1790011234 for v2 shim on 1% traffic :rocket:

sara: I'll draft the customer comms and FAQ. Need owners & deadlines.

alex: Owners: maria=docs/migration, jonathan=runtime shim, prasad=canary/metrics, sara=comm.s, eva=SDKs. I'll follow up with weekly checkins.

maria: Example header usage:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Compat: v1" \
     -d '{"input":"..."}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat
```

jonathan: SGTM :thumbsup:

maria: I'll open a tracking epic and PRs for each deliverable. Expect first RFC by EOD.
